name: @bloodtrail/security-audit-collector
description: Bounded non-production collector ingress for Bloodtrail security audit events

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run copy:generated
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage',{recursive:true})" && npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --enable-source-maps --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=25 --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=coverage/junit.xml dist-tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:matrix: npm run check:generated && npm run test:runtime
scripts.validate: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:scope && npm run test:dependencies && npm run test:package
